{{Quote|Exar Kun, because of you, the Sith will never die. You have earned the right to bear the mark of Dark Lord of the Sith.|Marka Ragnos, appointing Exar Kun as Dark Lord|audio=ExarKunCrownedDarkLord-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="audio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''mark of Dark Lord of the Sith'''<ref name="audio" /> was a [[Sith tattoo]]<ref name="NEGtC" /> worn on a forehead of a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="audio" /> The mark was worn by multiple Dark Lords, including [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]<ref name="gaots4" /> and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="dlots6" /> In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of a Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]] branded Kun with the mark of a Dark Lord and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] with [[Mark of Shadow Hand|that]] of a [[Shadow Hand]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
